vedic_reference.note: Balram is a name of Lord Krishna, who was born as the eighth son of King Ajamila and Queen Devaki. He is also known as Baladeva and Balabhadra.

Balram is also a name associated with leadership, courage, and the overcoming of obstacles.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, Balram represents the inner strength and resolve that helps us overcome difficulties and challenges in life.
